definitions.explanation: A retail shop where goods are sold without certain taxes. In Japan, this commonly refers to shops offering consumption tax exemption to foreign tourists, found in airports, department stores, and shopping districts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{免税店|めんぜいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I shopped at the duty-free store in the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{免税店|めんぜいてん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This is a tax-free store, so please show your passport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{免税店|めんぜいてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧{上|あ}げ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: With more foreign tourists, sales at duty-free shops are also growing.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {免税店|めんぜいてん} typically refers to stores offering ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧ (consumption tax) exemption to non-resident visitors. Many electronics stores, department stores, and drugstores in tourist areas now offer tax-free shopping. Look for the "Tax Free" sign.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧{免税店|めんぜいてん} (airport duty-free shop)
- {免税店|めんぜいてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy at a duty-free shop)
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (tax exemption procedure)
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧ (eligible for tax exemption)
